title: Macro-Driven Entity Family Refactor
description: Refactor semio/rs/lib.rs and semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql so all base functionality is macro-derived (edges, connections, hashing, diffs, modifications, owner unions, interface enums, operations, command navs, SDL fragments). Code-first: one entity_family! per entity emits the full 12-type ladder + Object impls + SDL fragment; gql::sdl() concatenates registered fragments instead of include_str! tautology; target.schema.graphql becomes a generated golden. Fixes all schema inconsistencies (duplicate Clump/TheKit, missing Stat/Layer/Group/Connection/Kit/Representation operation ladders, missing ClumpDiff ladder, FixedPiecesInput, ConnectionDiff body, normalized Modifications.owns comments). Multi-worker parallel execution: 1 coordinator + W0 foundation + W1-W6 entity conversion in parallel + W7 operations + W8 command navs + integrator + sweep. See plan e6121b3c for full DAG, worker manifest, region partitioning, subagent prompts, and concurrency safety rules.
